title: RELEASING.md: batch 52 leftovers
description: From batch 52 review (d62e4500): (1) Blocker 3 (new-crate limit: burst 5, then 1 per 10 min) still says 'publish with a script that retries on 429 after a few minutes'; name scripts/publish.sh and say a release adding many new crates will hit its 60-attempt (~70 min) cap and must be rerun (rerun resumes; published crates are skipped). (2) Blocker 4 says --allow-dirty is required for the bd:JMAP-31o4 workaround, but blocker 1 says that workaround is resolved; drop or fix the stale sentence. (3) 'Version bump conventions' still mentions a shared 0.1.X line.
